runs.text: The car park charges 3 pesos for the first hour and 2 pesos for each extra hour or part of an hour. Less than an hour is charged as one. Read the minutes and show the price. The program shows only the number.

hints.text: Build the partition: where does the way of charging change? Do worked examples on both sides of that edge.
150 minutes are one hour and 90 minutes more. How many hours or parts of an hour are those 90?
First decide whether the first hour has passed. If it has, round up the hours that follow.

runs.text: On Sundays the first hour is free. Add a second value, the day, and charge accordingly.
